word.ole_object_count: Number of embedded OLE (Object Linking and Embedding) components
word.ole_object_type_count: Number of unique OLE object types present in document
word.macro_present: Binary flag indicating whether Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) macros are detected
word.dde_present: Binary flag indicating whether Dynamic Data Exchange (DDE) command execution is present
word.vba_keywords_count: Count of suspicious VBA keywords and API calls (e.g., Shell, AutoOpen, CreateObject)
word.entropy: Overall Shannon file entropy (higher values indicate obfuscation, encryption, or packing)
word.struct_ContentType: Count of unique Content-Type declarations in document package ([Content_Types].xml)
word.struct_PartName: Count of internal archive part names and package relationship entries
word.file_size: Total document file size in bytes
word.struct_pos: Positional structural index of XML elements within the OOXML package

excel.entropy_of_text: Shannon entropy of textual cell contents (measure of text randomness or obfuscation)
excel.macro_chr_count: Total character count of embedded VBA macro code
excel.macro_vocab_size: Number of unique tokens/words used in VBA macro script
excel.macro_arithmetic_operator_count: Count of arithmetic operations in macros (frequently used in decryption loops)
excel.macro_token_count: Total token count of VBA macro instructions
excel.macro_max_line_length: Maximum character length of a single line in macro code (long lines indicate obfuscation)
excel.remote_template_present: Binary flag indicating whether remote template injection URLs exist
excel.numeric_cell_count: Total count of numeric cells across all worksheets
excel.string_cell_count: Total count of text/string cells across all worksheets
excel.avg_cell_length: Average character length of string cell contents

html.url_punct_char_count: Count of punctuation and special characters in embedded URLs
html.tag_count: Total count of HTML tags in the page DOM
html.whitespace_ratio: Ratio of whitespace characters relative to total document characters
html.entropy: Overall Shannon entropy of HTML source code
html.form_count: Number of interactive input forms (often used in credential harvesting)
html.embedded_js_count: Number of inline or embedded <script> tags
html.html_whitespace_ratio: Proportion of whitespace characters within HTML markup elements
html.script_entropy: Entropy of JavaScript code blocks (high entropy indicates packed/obfuscated JS)
html.min_link_length: Shortest URL length found in hyperlinks
html.external_link_count: Number of links pointing to external foreign domains
html.total_script_characters: Total character length of all JavaScript source code
html.internal_link_count: Number of links referencing internal relative domain paths
html.url_digit_count: Count of numerical digits in hyperlink URLs

pdf.text_length: Character count of extractable plain text (malicious dropper PDFs often contain near-zero text)
pdf.title_chars: Character length of document title in PDF metadata
pdf.file_size: Total PDF file size in bytes
pdf.object_count: Count of indirect PDF objects (obj ... endobj)
pdf.stream_count: Count of raw data stream objects (stream ... endstream)
pdf.endstream_count: Count of endstream markers (discrepancy with stream count indicates hidden payloads)
pdf.metadata_size: Size of metadata stream or dictionary in bytes
pdf.valid_pdf_header: Binary indicator for valid %PDF-1.x header signature at file start
pdf.entropy_of_streams: Average Shannon entropy across all compressed stream data
